name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Marketing Coordinator role because it's built around exactly the work I do hands-on today: HubSpot email campaigns, automated nurture workflows, and content that has to earn a B2B reader's attention. I've used HubSpot as my primary CRM across three roles - Level Agency, Fetch & Funnel, and Senior Directory - and I currently design and build full marketing-automation systems for my own clients.

At Solenzo, the company I founded, I've architected 20+ automated workflows covering lead capture, qualification, onboarding nurture, and long-term reactivation, and I write the email copy, landing pages, and newsletters that go with them myself. I track results in GA4 and CRM analytics and use what I find to keep improving the campaigns, which maps directly onto the KPI-tracking and reporting this role asks for. I'm also drawn to the mission here - nonprofit accounting is a specific, values-driven niche, and I like building marketing systems for organizations doing work I can stand behind.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how my HubSpot and automation background fits what you're building. Thank you for considering my application.
